subject: Dedicated capacity performance validation - latency & throughput SLOs (follow-up)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@vertexanalytics.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity performance validation - latency & throughput SLOs (follow-up)

Alex / Priya 

Following up on our discovery call: attaching an updated validation plan and a short runbook for the July 15 test window. Quick recap and what we'll validate: 
- P95 warm-path token latency target: <= 150 ms (Vertex confirmed).
- Cold-start first-token tolerance: up to 2.5s during autoscale (Vertex confirmed).
- Sustained throughput: target ~200 req/s (avg payload ~512 tokens).
- Peak concurrency: 32 sessions; test soak at 32 concurrent sessions for 45 minutes.
- Streaming: requirement is chunked responses with mean inter-burst <= 80ms.

We propose Redwood to run the orchestration from our agents in us-west-2 (we will provide a CIDR). Attached are the nvbench scripts and the matrix for H100-80GB, A100-80GB, A100-40GB. Please confirm:
1) Firewall/CIDR and ephemeral bastion by EOD Jul 14.
2) Whether you want encrypted payloads (KMS) or masked/plain payloads for the benchmark.
3) Any special compliance notes for our agents (SOC attestation).

Once we have those, Aditya will coordinate the run and Rafael will own results delivery.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

--
Attachment: dedicated-validation-plan.xlsx

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@vertexanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@vertexanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity performance validation - latency & throughput SLOs (follow-up)

Marissa 

Thanks for the follow-up and the plan. We can provide an ephemeral bastion and open a temporary VPN for Redwood agents. Action items from our side:
- Firewall/CIDR: 198.51.100.0/29 (will allow this for Jul 15 09:30-12:30 PT).
- Bastion host: will provide SSH jump details by EOD Jul 14.
- KMS: we'll prefer masked/plain payloads for the first run to reduce variability; we may re-run with encrypted payloads if needed.
- SOC note: brief attestation will be fine; send the template and we'll countersign.

Confirming Jul 15 10:00 PT for Redwood-managed run. Looking forward to the results dashboard.

Alex

--
Attachment: current_architecture-diagram.png

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@vertexanalytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity performance validation - latency & throughput SLOs (follow-up)

Alex / Team 

We're ready to run on Jul 15 at 10:00 PT. Quick confirmation of the test plan we'll execute:
- Phase 1: Cold-start micro-bench (single node warm/cold transitions) 
- Phase 2: Warm-path steady-state at 200 req/s with concurrency ramp to 32 (10 minute ramps)
- Phase 3: Soak at 32 concurrency for 45 minutes per GPU class

Sizing estimate for Vertex (preliminary):
- H100-80GB: ~6 nodes to meet sustained 200 req/s with 20% buffer
- A100-80GB: ~8 nodes for similar headroom
- A100-40GB: validate for bursts and cost comparison (likely more nodes)

We'll capture p50/p95/p99 token latency, inter-token burst timing for streaming, GPU utilization, network metrics, and provide a preliminary dashboard within 24 hours of completion. Posting our Redwood agent CIDR shortly (we will use 198.51.100.8/30 as our egress range).

- Aditya
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>

Alex / Priya 

Thanks for the IP and bastion details. We'll upload the redwood-runplaybook and a short SOC note to the DocuSign form and share the CIDR we'll use. After the run we'll deliver:
- A results dashboard (token latencies, throughput, streaming inter-burst stats)
- Raw logs and metrics (GPU perf counters, network traces)
- A sizing recommendation and cost comparison between H100/A100 variants

See you at 10:00 PT.

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
